name: BA_superstore_dashboard_Excel_DARK1
description: I used a retail sales dataset 10,000 transactions over four years and the question to start with was simple; the business is growing and yet profit margin is 12.5 percent. I tidied the data in Python, and this immediately drew my attention, almost 19 percent of the orders were negative profit. The less experienced version of me would delete them as mistakes, however, I checked them against the discount column and realized that they were the most significant rows in the dataset. There I constructed pivot analyses to discover precisely where the losses were being incurred - it turned out that three product lines were structurally unprofitable due to a discount policy having no limit. I estimated the damage, created an excel dashboard that could be used to continuously track it, and drafted five recommendations based on their financial projections. The top figure was 96,000 recoverable per year by merely capping discounts and altering the product mix in a single location.

CASE STUDY: Netflix User Engagement & Revenue Analysis
Project Overview

A comprehensive data analysis project analyzing Netflix-style streaming platform data using SQL for data extraction and Power BI for visualization. The project uncovers key insights about user behavior, content performance, and revenue trends.

PROBLEM STATEMENT

1. Business Challenge
2. User Engagement:
3. Content Performance
4. Revenue Analysis:
5. User Behavior:

  
SOLUTION APPROACH
1. Data Collection & Structure
2. SQL Implementation
3. Power BI Dashboard

KEY INSIGHTS DISCOVERED

1. Revenue Performance
    Total Revenue: $246.81
    Highest Month: October 2024 ($136.89)
    Growth: 251% increase from September to October
    Best Payment Method: Credit Card (45% of revenue)

2. User Engagement
    Active Users: 10 users (100% engagement)
    Average Engagement Score: 52.5
    Top User: Alex (Engagement Score: 59)
    Most Watched Genre: Sci-Fi (5 views)

3. Content Performance
    Top Movie: Multiple titles with 2+ views
    Best Genre: Sci-Fi and Drama (highest ratings)
    Device Preference: TV and Mobile (40% each)
    Average Completion Rate: 85.4%

4. Customer Insights
    Premium Users: 4 users (40%)
    Average Lifetime Value: $24.68
    Top Reviewer: Multiple users with 3 reviews each
    Geographic Distribution: 5 countries represented
